name: Mechanical keyboard, 75%
description: Hot-swappable switches, PBT keycaps, USB-C. So loud the whole open space knows when you're debugging.
review: Types 30% faster. My bugs also arrive 30% faster.

name: Wireless mouse
description: Silent clicks, 70-day battery. Right-click → Inspect has never felt this smooth.
review: Battery outlived three of our microservices.

name: Studio headphones
description: Closed-back, noise cancelling. The universal sign for “don't ask me if the server is down”.
review: Nobody has asked me to “quickly check something” since.

name: 1080p webcam
description: Full HD, stereo mics. Ships with a sticky note for “camera optional” meetings.
review: Crisp enough to see me mouthing “you're on mute”.

name: 24" IPS monitor
description: Full HD, IPS, height-adjustable. Room for your editor, your terminal and the Stack Overflow tab you're “just reading”.
review: Now I can see all 47 open tabs. Mistake.

name: USB-C hub, 7-in-1
description: HDMI 4K, 3 × USB-A, SD, 100 W pass-through. Finally, a dongle for your dongles.
review: One port to rule them all. Until it gets hot.

name: Raspberry Pi 4, 4 GB
description: A real Linux server the size of a credit card. Run nginx, Docker, or the home Kubernetes cluster you'll never finish.
review: Bought 1 for a weekend project. I now own 6 and no weekends.

name: Ethernet cable, 5 m
description: Cat 6, RJ45 both ends. Wi-Fi is just a cable with trust issues.
review: Ping went from 200 ms to 2 ms. My excuses went to 0.

name: Rubber duck
description: Senior debugging consultant. Listens to your whole bug, line by line. Never interrupts, never bills.
review: Fixed 3 bugs before I finished explaining them. Promote this duck.

name: Penguin plush
description: Tux, the Linux mascot. Soft, 30 cm, and never asks you to restart for updates.

name: Sticker pack, 50 pcs
description: Open source, Linux and cloud stickers. Makes your laptop 40% faster (source: trust me).
review: Laptop now runs Linux, Docker and my personality.

name: Developer coffee, 1 kg
description: Dark roast. Turns coffee into code. Out of stock: production incident, the whole team is on it.
